question: Does the enhanced photo show only real vessels?
task: A computer made the original photo (**A**) clearer (**B**). Choose **Yes** if every vessel in B is real, **No** if it made any up.
intro: A computer made each poor photo of the eye clearer. Sometimes it makes up blood vessels that are not really there. For each case, please tell us whether the enhanced photo (**B**) shows only real vessels.

fine.full: A vessel that faded or disappeared after enhancement.
A new vessel that is real, that is, you can find a faint trace of it in A or in the red-free close-up in D.
Changes in color, brightness, contrast or sharpness, and a smoother or grainier background.

not_fine.full: A vessel that is not in the original at all, not even faintly.

not_fine.short: real vessels moved, bent or joined wrongly
not_fine.full: A real vessel moved to another place, bent onto another path, or joined to a vessel it does not meet.

notes: The blue and red marks only show where to look; the computer can miss vessels or mark noise. Decide from the photos.
Not sure? Choose what you think is more likely and type “unsure” in the note.
